title: Schedule of Package Service Fees and Payment Terms — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**Package service fee.** Each In-Place Home Resale package carries a non-refundable package service fee charged when the resale file is opened; a package paid by commission carries a service fee of 0.00. Fees billed upfront are due within the number of calendar days after the charge shown below.

| Package | Package service fee (USD) | Upfront fees due (calendar days after the charge) | Fees still owed at closing deducted from the seller's sale proceeds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resale Approval Service | 395.00 | 15 | No |
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 795.00 | 15 | No |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 0.00 | 15 | Yes |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage | 0.00 | 15 | Yes |
| Full-Service Resale Brokerage Plus | 0.00 | 15 | Yes |
| Guaranteed Resale Program | 0.00 | 15 | Yes |

Where the last column reads Yes, Hearthstone Home Sales deducts the fees still owed on the file from the seller's sale proceeds at closing; where it reads No, it does not.

## Accepted payment channels (every package)

Fees billed upfront on an In-Place Home Resale file may be paid through any of these channels:

- a bank-account (ACH) payment through the resident portal;
- a debit or credit card payment through the resident portal;
- a money order handed to the community office;
- a cashier's check handed to the community office;
- a personal check handed to the community office.

## Rounding (every package)

Every computed charge and credit on an In-Place Home Resale file is rounded half up to the cent.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

| Package | Fee charged on | Amount | Due by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Marketed Listing Package | 4 May | 795.00 | 19 May |
| Resale Approval Service | 20 October | 395.00 | 4 November |
| Assisted Resale Listing | 4 May | 0.00 | no service fee is charged |
